-- Constructor standings for 2003 shows Minardi with 0 points.
-- So constructor_standings already correctly shows Minardi with 0.
-- My approach matches constructor_standings for 2003.
-- 
-- But wait - constructor_standings might be different from what we compute.
-- Let me check if constructor_standings points match our computed totals for some years.

-- Let me check 2020 constructor standings vs our computed totals
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
driver_season_total AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, d.surname, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id, d.surname
),
point_scoring_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, total_points
    FROM driver_season_total
    WHERE total_points > 0
),
constructor_driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, c.name, res.driver_id, 
           SUM(res.points) as constructor_driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN point_scoring_drivers psd ON res.driver_id = psd.driver_id AND r.year = psd.year
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id, c.name, res.driver_id
),
constructor_season_total AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, SUM(constructor_driver_points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_driver_points
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id, name
)
SELECT cst.name, cst.total_points, cs.points as cs_points
FROM constructor_season_total cst
JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON cst.year = lry.year
JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cst.constructor_id = cs.constructor_id AND cst.year = lry.year AND cs.race_id = lry.last_race_id
WHERE cst.year = 2020
ORDER BY cst.name
